ic_name: DALI (Digital Addressable Lighting Interface, IEC 62386 via TI SLAA422A)
protocol_type: Half-duplex addressed-bus request/(optional)reply messaging protocol. A control device transmits a 16-bit Manchester-encoded forward frame (1 start + 8-bit address byte + 8-bit data byte + 2 stop bits) onto a 2-wire DC bus. All control gear on the bus receive it; the addressed gear acts on the encoded command. For query commands only, the addressed gear responds with an 8-bit backward frame (1 start + 8-bit data byte + 2 stop bits) sent 7×TE..22×TE after the end of the forward frame. There is no NACK and no per-frame ACK — unsupported or malformed forward frames are silently discarded.

opcodes.name: UP
opcodes.description: Fade up for 200 ms at the configured Fade Rate.

opcodes.name: DOWN
opcodes.description: Fade down for 200 ms at the configured Fade Rate.

opcodes.name: STEP UP
opcodes.description: Increment Actual Level by one step.

opcodes.name: STEP DOWN
opcodes.description: Decrement Actual Level by one step.

opcodes.name: STEP DOWN AND OFF
opcodes.description: Decrement Actual Level; if at Minimum Level, turn the lamp off.

opcodes.name: ON AND STEP UP
opcodes.description: Increment Actual Level; if currently off, turn the lamp on first.

opcodes.name: ENABLE DAPC SEQUENCE
opcodes.description: Fade rate is bypassed; following direct arc-power commands apply immediately.

opcodes.name: RESET
opcodes.description: Reset all variables to their default values.

opcodes.name: STORE DTR AS MAX LEVEL .. FADE RATE
opcodes.description: Store DTR into Maximum Level, Minimum Level, System Failure Level, Power On Level, Fade Time, Fade Rate respectively (one variable per code 42..47).

opcodes.name: QUERY STATUS
opcodes.description: Backward = 8-bit Status (bit 0 status of gear, bit 1 lamp failure, bit 2 lamp on, bit 3 limit error, bit 4 fade running, bit 5 reset state, bit 6 missing short address, bit 7 power failure).

opcodes.name: QUERY BALLAST
opcodes.description: Backward = 0xFF (YES) if the gear is present.

opcodes.name: QUERY LIMIT ERROR
opcodes.description: Backward = 0xFF if last requested level was outside Min/Max.

opcodes.name: QUERY MISSING SHORT ADDRESS
opcodes.description: Backward = 0xFF if no short address is currently assigned.

opcodes.name: QUERY VERSION NUMBER
opcodes.description: Backward = version of the protocol implemented (e.g. 0x01).

opcodes.name: QUERY DEVICE TYPE
opcodes.description: Backward = device-type code (e.g. 0x06 LED module = IEC 62386-207).

opcodes.name: QUERY range continued 154..155 + 160..165 + 176..196 + 237..241 + 252..255
opcodes.description: Additional queries: physical minimum level, content of Min/Max Level, Fade Time/Rate, Random Address, scene level X, group membership low/high, device-type-specific queries (IEC 62386-2xx).

opcodes.name: READ MEMORY LOCATION
opcodes.description: Backward = memory[(DTR1 << 8) | DTR] of memory bank DTR2; DTR auto-increments.

opcodes.name: STORE DTR AS FAST FADE TIME
QUERY continued 237..241 + 252..255
opcodes.description: Includes QUERY EXTENDED VERSION NUMBER 0xFF (data=0xFF backward), QUERY DEVICE TYPE feature flags, etc.

special_commands.name: TERMINATE
special_commands.description: Exit Configuration Mode; clear initialization flag.

special_commands.name: DTR (Data Transfer Register)
special_commands.description: DTR := data byte. Used as argument by STORE DTR AS ... commands and by READ/WRITE MEMORY LOCATION.

special_commands.name: INITIALIZE
special_commands.data_byte: 0x00 = all, 0xFF = gear without short address, 0AAAAAA0 = specific short address
special_commands.description: Enter Configuration Mode for 15 min or until TERMINATE.

special_commands.name: RANDOMIZE
special_commands.description: All Configuration-Mode gear regenerate their 24-bit Random Address.

special_commands.name: COMPARE
special_commands.description: All Configuration-Mode gear with Random Address ≤ Search Address answer 0xFF (YES).

special_commands.name: WITHDRAW
special_commands.description: Configuration-Mode gear with Random Address == Search Address drop out of the addressing iteration.

special_commands.name: PROGRAM SHORT ADDRESS
special_commands.description: Short address of the matching Configuration-Mode gear is updated.

special_commands.name: VERIFY SHORT ADDRESS
special_commands.description: Gear with this short address answers 0xFF (YES).

special_commands.name: QUERY SHORT ADDRESS
special_commands.description: Gear with Random Address == Search Address answers its short address (or 0xFF).

special_commands.name: PHYSICAL SELECTION
special_commands.description: Select the gear that the installer has physically marked (vendor-defined).

special_commands.name: ENABLE DEVICE TYPE X
special_commands.description: Enable device-type-specific extended command set for the next forward frame only.

special_commands.name: DTR1
special_commands.description: DTR1 := data byte (memory bank address high or scene base register, device-type specific).

special_commands.name: WRITE MEMORY LOCATION (NOT SUPPORTED in TI app)
special_commands.description: memory[(DTR1<<8)|DTR][DTR2] := data. Not implemented in SLAA422A (would conflict with the < 9.17 ms flash erase/program time).

function_code_ranges.indirect_command_range: 0x00..0xFF when address byte's B bit = 1 (Y=0 short, Y=1 group/broadcast).
function_code_ranges.direct_arc_power_range: 0x00..0xFE = level 0..254 (0xFF = MASK) when address byte's B bit = 0.
function_code_ranges.special_command_address_range: Address byte 0xA0..0xCF with bit B=1 selects a Special Command (TERMINATE..WRITE MEMORY LOCATION).
function_code_ranges.broadcast_address_byte: 0xFE (Y=1 + AAAAAA=111111 + B=0) for direct level / 0xFF (Y=1 + AAAAAA=111111 + B=1) for indirect command.
function_code_ranges.group_address_range: 0..15 (encoded YAAAAAAB with Y=1 and AAAAAA low-2 = 00).

exception_codes.name: No NACK in DALI
exception_codes.meaning: DALI has no explicit failure-acknowledge frame. Unsupported / malformed / out-of-window forward frames are silently discarded.

exception_codes.name: Backward-frame collision
exception_codes.meaning: If two control gear answer in the 7..22 TE window (only possible during faulty broadcast queries) the bus is driven by both and the response is corrupted.

exception_codes.name: Query timeout
exception_codes.meaning: Control device shall treat the absence of a backward frame within 22×TE after the forward frame as a no-response.

channels.name: DALI 2-wire bus (DA+/DA-)
channels.framing: Manchester (bi-phase) at 1200 baud; start bit + 8/16 data bits + 2 stop bits
channels.error_check: None at the protocol layer — DALI relies on Manchester self-clocking + silent-discard.

host_bus_interface: Implementation-specific. In SLAA422A the host bus is the MSP430 internal AHB/peripheral fabric: DALI_RX is a GPIO (P2.0) with interrupt-on-edge, DALI_TX is a GPIO (P2.1), Timer_A3 drives the LED PWM outputs, and the Watchdog Timer Plus interval mode generates the fade and special-command timing. No standardized CPU bus is defined by IEC 62386.
valid_ready_handshake_rules: DALI is strictly forward-frame-then-optional-backward-frame; there is no per-byte ACK at the bus layer.
Backward frames are sent only as response to query forward frames; the control gear must wait 7×TE..22×TE before driving its first backward bit.
No backward frame shall be sent by an un-addressed gear or in response to a non-query command.
Control device shall wait ≥ 22×TE (9.17 ms) before transmitting the next forward frame; an extended 13.5 ms inter-frame settle is recommended.
Special commands TERMINATE, RANDOMIZE, COMPARE, WITHDRAW, SEARCH/PROGRAM/VERIFY/QUERY SHORT ADDRESS are the only commands valid in Configuration Mode addressing-iteration.
Two consecutive identical commands within a 100 ms window are required to commit a destructive configuration command (RESET, STORE DTR AS SHORT ADDRESS, STORE DTR AS SCENE, etc.) per IEC 62386-102.

frame_format_forward.data_byte: 8 bits, MSB first; meaning depends on B bit of address byte (direct level vs indirect command).
frame_format_forward.total_bits_on_wire: 16 information bits + 1 start + 2 stop ≈ 19 bit-times Manchester.

frame_format_backward.data_byte: 8 bits, MSB first; encoding depends on the originating query.
frame_format_backward.total_bits_on_wire: 8 information bits + 1 start + 2 stop ≈ 11 bit-times Manchester.
frame_format_backward.timing: Starts between 7×TE and 22×TE after the end of the corresponding forward frame.
